claims.text: The experimental results include held-out test results for the model that achieved the best performance on the development set, reported using Proportional and Binary precision, recall, and F1 scores.
The results are intended as benchmarks for further experiments in predicting holders, targets, and polar expressions in a sequence labeling task.
The paper discusses the first experimental results on the dataset, indicating the effectiveness of the annotation effort and the model's performance.
